shots.detail_en: CH at dawn in the empty hall, his mop dragging one long wet line across the tiles like a rising candle, the camera tilting up the handle to his face turned up at the dark flip-board
shots.sub: 旁白："联华的钟响之前，这块大屏先听我说早安。"
shots.speaker: 旁白

shots.detail_en: CH whispering before the board: 联华码头's three green bars shrinking day by day, the volume tag shrunk to a bean
shots.sub: 长："跌得越来越小声——不像杀人。"
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: CH pulls his father's worn notebook from his work jacket, opening it in the glow of the board
CH steadying the page: a hand-drawn candle chart annotated with one line — the knife formula
shots.sub: 旁白："父亲的本子里，洗盘和杀人，隔一行字。"
shots.speaker: 旁白

shots.detail_en: CH closes the notebook and looks back up at the board, green light settling in his eyes
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: Wide: the opening bell detonates and the retail crowd floods in through three doors, the hall boiling over
MANCANG in a sweat-soaked flowered shirt squeezes out of the crowd and shoves his pager at CH
shots.sub: 满："完了完了！我又全仓了！全仓碰上跳水——这不是割肉，是凌迟！"
shots.speaker: MANCANG

shots.detail_en: Close-up: the board slams one more green bar onto 联华码头, the crowd stepping back half a pace
shots.sub: 散户甲（画外）："割了！神仙来了也要割！"
shots.speaker: 散户甲

shots.detail_en: MANCANG scrawls a sell slip and lunges for the counter; CH's hand clamps down on his wrist
shots.sub: 满："让我割！再晚骨头都没了！"
shots.speaker: MANCANG

shots.detail_en: CH's eyes on the board, steady as the line of handwriting in his father's notebook
shots.sub: 长："刀落三次不破底，是吓人，不是杀人。满仓——把单子吃回去。"
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: Triple quick cuts: the green bar's third dip stopping dead at the same low / CH's grip on MANCANG's wrist / the volume tag shrinking to its smallest
shots.sub: 旁白："第三次，刀尖钉在同一个位置。恐慌，是排练过的。"
shots.speaker: 旁白

shots.detail_en: Wide: a red bar shoots up out of the ground on 联华码头, the green sea flipping red, heads snapping around
shots.speaker: 散户群

shots.detail_en: MANCANG buckles against a pillar, wadding the sell slip back into his pocket
shots.sub: 满："吓死人……差点把全家的骨头割在地板价上。"
shots.speaker: MANCANG

shots.detail_en: RED leaning into the glass at her counter, voice dropped low, fingertip resting on a receipt stub
shots.sub: 红："陆先生，你的委托单第三联，被二楼借走了。"
shots.speaker: RED

shots.detail_en: RED slides a photocopied stub under the glass, a red 'checked' chop stamped in its corner
shots.sub: 红："账目不会说谎——有人天天在查你。"
shots.speaker: RED

shots.detail_en: CH's grip tightens on the mop as his eyes climb to the smoky glass of the second-floor VIP seats
XIONGWEI in the Lianhua tower archive room at night, pushing a 1993 surveillance tape into the deck, the spool mirrored in his lenses
shots.sub: 熊伟："先看 1993 年 6 月 17 日——他父亲停机的那天。"
shots.speaker: XIONGWEI

shots.detail_en: FATHER in snowy 1993 monitor footage: the old hall surging with a crowd, an old-suited figure glimpsed only from the back
BOY in the frozen footage crawling slower frame by frame: a boy in the corner of the crowd tilting his head up at the old board, his face eerily like the young sweeper
shots.sub: 熊伟（画外）："把这张脸……放大。"
shots.speaker: XIONGWEI

shots.detail_en: CH after close, pulling open his cleaning locker to stow the mop — freezing mid-motion
End-hook close-up: beneath his work badge lies XIONG's business card, flattened and pressed flat — the one CH crumpled into the rain, its water stains still on it
Black frame with the episode-end teaser card
shots.card: 扔进雨里的东西，自己走回来了。明天——刀要落第四次。
